raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivered 333 transactions at 05:00 with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716039000) instead of the ISO string. That value equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, the same instant as the original 02:00 copy, so the failing cast is a format mismatch and the re-delivery also double-counts every affected transaction. The fix is to parse epoch-ms strings with epoch_ms, keep one row per txn_id (the earliest ingest), and leave the gold steps unchanged since they read silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1);"}}
